attestations.note: The Romanian day is 24 octombrie, not the 16 септември ст. ст. the Russian row holds, and doxologia gives no reason for the difference. Its life is the same story — a disciple of the Apostle Paul, under Domitian, at the city of Marcian, the furnace she came out of unhurt, the beasts that lay down like lambs, the beheading, the milk instead of blood, the sack of lead thrown into the sea and the body brought ashore — but it names the governor Serghie where the Russian life names George. Read 24 September 2026.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 24ης Οκτωβρίου — «Αγία Σεβαστιανή»

attestations.note: The life page `https://www.saint.gr/2531/saint.aspx` heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 24 Οκτωβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder already keeps for the Romanian church, and the entry is the same woman — and this row **replaces an `undocumented` note that said saint.gr did not keep her at all**: that note recorded 16 and 29 Σεπτεμβρίου as checked and found wanting, which was true of those two days and not of 24 Οκτωβρίου. The page makes her a native of Sebaste in Phrygia, taught the faith by the apostle Paul, living in the first century at Marcianopolis in Thrace, arrested under the emperor Domitian and the governor Sergius, driven out, arrested again at Heraclea in Thrace by the governor Pompeianus, beheaded, and buried at Rhaidestos. It gives the century and the reign but no year, so the folder's existing `dates` are left untouched. No hymn; no asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.
Not in the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for 29.09.2026 (16. септембар ст. ст.) (checked 2026-09-17); no other day checked.
